targetAudience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on
topic: Sahih al-Bukhari 69: make things easy for people
coreInsight: In Sahih al-Bukhari 69 the Prophet ﷺ tells us to make things easy for people, give good news, and not drive them away.
selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

script.onScreen: Make it easy, not heavy. / A hadith, with context.

REFLECTION / What it teaches / This hadith is about how we share the deen with others: make it easier to come close, give good news, and don't push people away. It shapes how we remind family, friends and anyone new to practice.
IN PRACTICE / Lead with mercy, not mistakes · Answer questions patiently · Encourage small steps
Make the way easier. / Share it with someone who teaches

caption:
How we remind people matters as much as what we say.

Sahih al-Bukhari 69: make things easy, give good tidings, don't drive people away.

Swipe for what it teaches and three ways to live it.
